rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=40, recon_eta=30.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=120, train_n=0, rationale=iter-6 search-20260619-01 CONSTRAINED diff-recon — AUDIT CODE-FIX VALIDATION (user-directed 2026-06-20). ONE KNOB: recon_dc_solver legacy->cg (NEW config-gated correct DC path in solver_diffusion_recon.py; legacy path byte-for-byte preserved + reproducible for all prior cfgs). The audit found the legacy DC-step is (1) a MISLABELED steepest-descent dressed as CG (dc_step_cg lines ~83-100) and (2) a re-injection that recomputes x0 from a STALE eps via x0_from_eps(x,eps,ab_next) then re-noises with a FRESH randn mid-schedule (lines ~162-174) — this collapsed unconstrained iter-4 to SSIM 0.055 and kept the constrained variant stuck 0.24-0.66 << the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor at hr=0. THE FIX (ported from the corrected solver_fast_recon.cg_data_consistency): recon_dc_solver=cg swaps in a GENUINE Fletcher-Reeves CG solve of AtA x = At y (residual + conjugate direction + FR beta), forms x0 from the CURRENT step's eps (x0_hat at t_now, not a stale eps re-eval'd at the wrong alpha_bar), CG-projects it, then re-embeds at t_next DETERMINISTICALLY as sqrt(ab_next)*x0_proj_norm + sqrt(1-ab_next)*eps_pred reusing the SAME eps (eps-prediction => the level-t noise direction IS eps_pred) — NO fresh randn, NO stale eps. BASE = iter-5 BEST (T=40, eta=30, relax=1.0, every5/n_cg3/warmup5, val_n=120, SSIM 0.6647/hr0 — the run-best constrained config). Hard DC stays ON (recon_dcstep_every=5) now that it is CORRECT. HONEST EXPECTATION: the corrected CG-DC should STOP the legacy re-noise corruption and likely RAISE SSIM above iter-5's 0.6647 (the deterministic same-eps re-embed no longer overwrites the trajectory with fresh noise + a least-squares fit to the noisy 2304-view LD sinogram). But on DENSE rebinned Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete at 2304 views) the v4 DDPM prior is regime-bounded, so hr may STILL be ~0 — the real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks + the planned EMA v5 prior. This iter VALIDATES the fix RUNS and is NON-REGRESSIVE/non-corrupting under the corrected metric. FALSIFIER: if SSIM drops below iter-5's 0.6647 the corrected re-embed is mis-scaling x0 vs eps; if it clears the ~0.81 FBP floor (hr>0) the legacy bug was the whole story. BUDGET: recon_dc_solver=cg is roughly cost-neutral vs legacy (the DPS forward+grad per step is unchanged; the CG inner loop does forward+back per n_cg, comparable to legacy dc_step_cg's forward+back+forward; the deterministic re-embed drops the randn). iter-5 ran T=40 x val_n=120 in 988.0 s = 16.5 min < the HARD 1200s/20-min budget (1800s in-solver backstop + 30-min --time). val_n=120 held at iter-5's value (no reduction needed — 988s leaves ~3.5 min headroom for the CG path's marginal delta). val=120 evenly-spaced L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, reuse ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt (NO retrain), 321px FOV.
